newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA strong as tender decision looms.
newsitem.headline: CA strong as tender decision looms.

text.p: Preferred shares in Creditanstalt Bankverein firmed 5.81 percent in Vienna on brisk turnover on Friday ahead of a finance ministry decision on whether to reopen a tender for the state's 70 percent of ordinary shares.
At 1236 GMT Creditanstalt preferred were 27 schillings up at 491.50 on turnover of 57,962 lots, making the stock the ATX index's biggest gainer and second most actively traded share.
Some dealers traced the rise to investor interest from abroad but most said market makers were behind the move.
"Institutional investors don't want to touch Creditanstalt with a barge pole at the moment," a trader said. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
